about_the_game:
Welcome to Trishu-Drift

The better you drift, the faster you go!

Immerse yourself in the art of drifting with Trishu-Drift, where precision and style lead to speed and victory.

Drifting made unique:

Enhance your driving strategy with unique mechanics:

  • Nitrous: Earn nitrous by executing perfect drifts, passing your opponents and winning the race

Master the balance between drifting and speed to dominate the competition.

Touge Challenges

Test your skills on challenging mountain passes inspired by iconic Japanese touge:

  • Intense Downhill Races: Navigate tight corners and steep descents that demand precision and control. Drive faster than the other racers and reach the finish line first

  • Head-To-Head: Drift through the streets, avoid traffic and earn more points than your opponents

Experience the thrill of downhill racing that rewards mastery and finesse.

Open World Exploration

Navigate through diverse environments:

  • City Streets: Race through urban landscapes illuminated by the glow of streetlights.

  • Mountain Roads: Challenge yourself on winding paths with breathtaking views.

  • Abandoned Airports: Utilize vast open spaces for high-speed stunts and drifts.

Discover hidden spots to perfect your drifting and perform stunts like jumping over traffic, rivers, or even entire hangars.

Multiplayer and PvP

Compete with friends and players worldwide:

  • Online PvP Modes: Engage in competitive drifting battles.

  • Leaderboards: Showcase your drifting skills and climb the global rankings.

Prove your skills in a community of drift enthusiasts.

Customization and Tuning

Create your dream drift car with extensive options:

  • Visual Customization: Modify body kits, liveries, rims, and more to reflect your style.

  • Performance Tuning: Adjust engine performance, suspension, and other parameters to suit your preferences.

Customize your vehicle to match your style!
